# Overtime Pay Guidance for the 06/13/2026 Workweek
Payroll interpretation memo

## To and purpose
To: Jamal Whitfield, Operations Manager
From: Alicia Navarro, HR Specialist
Date: 06/16/2026
Subject: Federal overtime treatment for the workweek ending 06/13/2026

This memo applies the federal Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) to Tidewater's nonexempt employees. The workweek is Sunday through Saturday and is a fixed, recurring 7-day period. Hours worked across two workweeks are not averaged to avoid overtime. The records below show hours actually worked; paid leave is not included as hours worked.

| Employee | Classification | Rate | Hours worked | Regular hours | Overtime hours |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Linh Abbott | Nonexempt | $20.00/hour | 42 | 40 | 2 |
| Jamal Whitfield | Nonexempt | $24.00/hour | 46 | 40 | 6 |

## Pay calculation and treatment
For Linh, regular pay is 40 × $20.00 = $800.00. The overtime rate is 1.5 × $20.00 = $30.00 per hour, and overtime pay is 2 × $30.00 = $60.00. Linh's gross wages total $850.00 before deductions.

For Jamal, regular pay is 40 × $24.00 = $960.00. The overtime rate is 1.5 × $24.00 = $36.00 per hour, and overtime pay is 6 × $36.00 = $216.00, for gross wages of $1,176.00 before deductions.

Tidewater may bank compensatory time instead of paying overtime for these nonexempt private-sector employees. Any overtime worked must be paid at the applicable rate, even if it was not authorized in advance; managers may address violations of the approval process separately. Payroll should retain the time records and calculations with the pay-period records.

errors.quote: Linh's gross wages total $850.00 before deductions.
errors.explanation: The memo gives Linh regular pay of $800.00 and overtime pay of $60.00. Those amounts total $860.00, not $850.00.
errors.fix: Linh’s gross wages total $860.00 before deductions.

errors.quote: may bank compensatory time instead of paying overtime
errors.explanation: The FLSA generally does not allow a private-sector employer to substitute compensatory time off for overtime pay owed to nonexempt employees. The memo identifies these employees as nonexempt and Tidewater as a private-sector employer.
errors.fix: may not bank compensatory time instead of paying overtime
